Question
========
Why can the current tax system create incentives towards "excessive automation"?

Answerlist
----------
* Because labour is taxed heavily relative to capital, making machines artificially cheap
* Because robots pay income tax
* Because automation is subsidised by trade unions
* Because capital is taxed more than labour

Solution
========
Heavy taxes and social contributions on labour, compared with capital, push firms to replace workers even where productivity gains are small.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
